column1: # KD11-B microprogram flow, K-MP-KD11-B-1 rev A, 27-JUL-72: 22 pages in the October 1973
# PDP-11/05 engineering drawing set (M7261 rev E). Transcribed by eye from the scan, page by
# page, in printed order. Despite its name the "flow" is a commented listing: a routine
# heading (printed with a leading *), comments (printed with a leading /) and one line per
# microword giving its address, next address, tag and what it does.
# Printer glyphs are written as meant: the arrow as U+2190, the dash in a tag as -, the
# statement separator as ;, a slashed zero as 0. Spelling, abbreviations and the document's
# own slips are kept as printed. Page 1 is the revision control sheet and is not transcribed.
# The CATEGORY column is NOT printed in the document. It is this project's grouping of the
# routines, one of FETCH SOURCE DESTINATION EXECUTE TRAP CONSOLE POWER SERVICE.
# Every WORD line's LOC, NXT and TAG is checked against the listing by Kd11bFlowTest. They
# agree for all 201 microwords the flow shows; page 22 names the 13 it does not.

column2: NOTES ON NOTATION:
1. MICROROUTINES BEGIN WITH A COMMENT
THE FIRST CHARACTER OF WHICH IS '*'.
2. ALL OTHER COMMENTS BEGIN WITH '/'.
3. R[N] REFERRS SCRATCH PAD REGISTER N.
R[7] IS ALSO REFERRED TO AS 'PC'.
4. R[S] REFERRS TO THAT REGISTER SPECIFIED
IN THE SOURCE PORTION OF THE CURRENT INST.
(IR<11:9>). LIKEWISE, R[D] REFERRS TO THAT
REG SPECIFIED IN THE DESTINATION PORTION OF
THE CURRENT INST. (IR<2:0>).
5. K[N] REFERRS TO THAT LOCATION OF THE
CONSTANTS CHIP CONTAINING THE CONSTANT N.
6. 'BUT' STANDS FOR 'BRANCH ON MICRO TEST'.
